what: The telemetry module's hook list (and the brief built on it) called each hook 'a small edit', but three hooks need a design the runtime does not have yet: Cx::span returns a child Cx and has no close, so Cell::open has nowhere to pair a Cell::close; charge_wait gets (on, id, ns), not the task id and start/end a WaitRec holds; and blaze-cli parses its --stats flag inside main, after bstd's pool and workers' cells are made, so a level 'in the runtime's options' cannot be set from that flag without a run-time raise.
class: a hook list written from the telemetry side without reading the seams it names
prevention: read each named seam before calling a hook small; the hook list in telemetry.rs should name the seam's current signature
annoyance: the brief's 'each a small edit' read as done-in-minutes; it is a spec first
workaround: declared the module, fixed Waited's merge order, added the frame-pointer lines; the hooks are specified in the final report, not edited
